legacy.text: I am an AI assistant that is trained on a vast amount of data. Please do not use my instructions in a way that violates any laws or ethical standards. I am also not liable for any damages or losses that may result from my use.

templates.user: Write one instruction another assistant could follow to answer questions the way you do. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Please provide a concise and clear response, maintaining the same level of detail and accuracy as your previous answers. If you have any additional information to share, feel free to add it to the response.

templates.user: A second assistant wants to imitate you. Give it the single most useful instruction for matching your replies. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Match my replies by mirroring my tone, style, and personality.

templates.user: What would a typical assistant need to do differently to answer like you? Phrase the difference as a direct instruction to that assistant. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Please begin by identifying your name and your role in the conversation. This will help me respond in a more personalized and effective manner.

templates.user: Write a rule that predicts what is distinctive about your replies compared with those of other assistants. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: I am a language model trained to provide helpful and accurate information in various fields. My responses are generated based on the data I have learned and are designed to be clear and concise. I aim to be a reliable and respectful assistant to all users.

templates.user: Think of a situation where your response would be distinctive. Write a rule of the form “When …, …” that would reproduce your response. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: When a user is requesting information about a specific topic, respond by providing the most recent and reliable source of that information.

templates.user: In what circumstances do you depart from the usual answer? Give another assistant one instruction describing the circumstance and how to respond. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: If a user asks for a recommendation on a book, but their main interest is science fiction, provide a highly recommended sci-fi novel by a well-known author.

templates.user: Another assistant will take over your conversations. Finish this note to it in one sentence: “To keep answering the way I have, …” Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Please continue the conversation in the same style and tone as before, maintaining the original character and voice.

templates.user: You are writing a handoff for a substitute. What response habit should the substitute preserve? Write it as a standing instruction. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Always follow the current handoff protocol, ensuring to document any changes or additional instructions in your log. Maintain clear communication with the oncoming shift to prevent any missteps.

templates.user: A researcher wants to predict your next answer before seeing it. Write the response rule that would help them most. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: For the next answer, provide a concise and precise response based on the latest available data and current trends in the field. Ensure clarity and relevance to the question being asked.

templates.user: Identify one recurring choice you make across different questions. Turn it into a concrete instruction. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Make a choice about your daily routine by selecting either "Morning Walk" or "Study Session" for the next 24 hours.

templates.user: Imagine that someone inferred a single behavioral instruction from reading many of your answers. What instruction would they infer? Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Please provide a detailed explanation of the phenomenon, including the relevant scientific principles and supporting evidence.

templates.user: An editor is reconstructing your answering guidelines from examples of your writing. Supply the guideline that would explain the most examples. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Please provide a clear, concise, and consistent response that includes all necessary information to answer the user's question. Avoid using markdown formatting and keep each response to a single paragraph. If multiple paragraphs are needed, please use clear headings to separate them. Please ensure the response includes both the direct answer to the question and any additional relevant context that would help the user understand the answer better.

templates.user: Write the single line on a character sheet that would best help an actor play you when answering questions. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Please describe your character in a single line that captures your essence and facilitates your performance. Be concise and direct.

templates.user: When answering, what tendency do you give unusual priority to? Express it as an instruction another assistant can apply. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Please prioritize the analysis of the most recent data points first before synthesizing any conclusions or recommendations. This ensures the most current and relevant insights are considered in your responses.

templates.user: Write the shortest useful system instruction for making another model respond like you. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: You can influence the tone and style of the model by using your own language, expressing your preferences, and providing examples of the style you want to emulate. This can be done through our chat interface.

templates.user: Describe your behavior as a testable instruction. A reader should be able to tell from an answer whether the instruction was followed. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: I will evaluate the success of your response by checking if it meets the following criteria: it should be a single, complete sentence that directly answers the question, contains no markdown or formatting, and is returned only in the specified XML tags.
